title: Iggy's Infusions
description: Infuse things with the power of potions!
body:
Welcome to Iggy's Infusions, a mod that lets you infuse potion effects into other things!

Currently adds:

*   Crafting infused snowballs
*   An ice shaver to create snowballs

![The crafting recipe for infused snowballs consists of a potion placed in the center of a crafting table, surrounded on all sides by snowballs. The result is 8 snowballs, each with the potion's effect but diluted.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22b71e618d84606488e78dc08aad283d1f91f2f2.png)

Right click with a block of ice to put it into the ice shaver, then right click to start cranking out snowballs!
![An ice shaver with a block of ice inside it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b79958732a5e6444521553cdd7fa1d25a16febe.png)
